title: MTSD launches long-range facilities master planning process districtwide
text:
Schools
MTSD launches long-range facilities master planning process districtwide
Mequon-Thiensville School District has started a long-range facilities master planning process, according to the district.
The Mequon-Thiensville School District has launched a long-range facilities master planning process, according to a district newsletter announced Wednesday, Oct. 28, 2026.
The process will assess how classrooms and shared spaces support modern teaching practices and evaluate building capacity and section needs, including spatial capacity at Oriole Lane, using updated demographic data, the district said.
The planning effort also includes creating a predictable 10-year maintenance plan to maintain building mechanical systems such as HVAC, electrical and plumbing, along with structural envelopes and safety infrastructure, according to the district. The district said it will model adaptable financial scenarios intended to ensure operational stability across school environments, and will integrate high school athletic facility planning into its broader districtwide facility schedule.
In the same newsletter, the district reported results from its 2026 September Family Survey. MTSD achieved an overall Net Promoter Score of 55, matching last year's rating, with elementary families accounting for 60% of all responses, according to the district. The district reported that 86% of new families enrolled because of the district's academic reputation, 93% of respondents said their children feel safe at school, 88% said they felt well-prepared and welcomed before the first day of school, and 85% of families transitioning to new buildings said orientation eased the move.
The newsletter also noted that the district's 2027-28 school year calendars have been approved, though specific dates were not included in the posting.
Source: Steffen Middle School, https://steffen.mtsd.k12.wi.us/index.php?pageID=smartSiteFeed&psqFeed=true&articleID=94611391
